The [3,3] stub (cost 5, strong-class) solos route-2 and is retreated at ~frame 390, banking a refund that funds the anchor inside the EXP-006 survival window. Cost-6 duelist-class bodies (talr/nothin) solo routes 7 and 6 at one-third of OP-02's assumed price. Route-8 is the single planned conditional concession (unblockable, IR_04 empty) unless the verifier proves the roadblock-diverted path makes it cheaply killable. A flamtl-class battery on path-free [9,4] cycles +6 DP every ~18s from ~frame 1070 to fund the W05 [6,2] heavy and W06 flex.
